Strategy rules

Strategy: Daily Swing with Weekly Channel Filter

Enter long on an oversold dip holding the weekly channel

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN RSI crosses below 30 (oversold) (rsi_oversold(30)) AND close is above weekly_low
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 + take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit long on an overbought spike

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN RSI crosses above 70 (overbought) (rsi_overbought(70))
THEN close the position

Enter short on an overbought spike capped by the weekly channel

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN RSI crosses above 70 (overbought) (rsi_overbought(70)) AND close is below weekly_high
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 - take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit short on an oversold dip

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN RSI crosses below 30 (oversold) (rsi_oversold(30))
THEN close the position
